# Public attachment regression fixtures

These two files are the original mo7 images in the public input for SWE-bench Multimodal Prettier 16347. They test input delivery, GIF frame handling and content deduplication. Files are unchanged and named by SHA-256; original URLs, aliases, byte counts and hashes are in the [fixture manifest](../arena-inputs.json). Frozen copies are retained because the original host is not reliably downloadable. Copyright remains with the original authors; these attachments are not relicensed under the project's Apache-2.0 code license.

The fixtures contain no answers, candidate patches or grading assets. CI uses an authored marker task and a deterministic model fixture to validate file and visual delivery, not original-task model performance.
